name: hyperdns
//: src/ has zero runtime dependencies and requires nothing: the caller hands it a hypergraph/next instance (hg) and does the networking itself (hg.connectToSwarm()). hypergraph is a real dependency because the shell (bin/cli.js, shell/) opens its own instance; tests use hypergraph/testing. hypergraph is not on npm yet, so it is declared as file:../hypergraph - npm install links this repo to the sibling checkout (npm 12 also blocks git dependencies by default). The hypergraph checkout must sit next to this repo.
